name: list_environments
title: List the environments
description: The environments of your organization: id, HRID and name, whether you can read their traffic, and how many of their APIs you can see. Every other tool takes `environment` as the id, the HRID or the name listed here.

readable.description: Whether you may read the traffic of this environment.

visibleApis.description: How many APIs of this environment you can see. Absent when it is not readable.
